compiler_disposition.decision: PGO gain is below measurement noise across two order-balanced pairs; retain portable O3. PGO raw training was ~16x slower than non-instrumented screening.
compiler_disposition.portable_O3: Retain as the compiler baseline and selected build.

identity_note: The initial O3/native/LTO builds have a different builder-script SHA/source_digest from later current-builder chunk/profile/PGO builds. Phase2 verified native/bridge/vendor hashes and effective native compile/link behavior; the difference is builder bookkeeping (including preserved OpenMP LTO/PGO link flags/effective compiler identity), not a native C source change.
parity: parity_gate.json: all seven builds passed exact natural Python/direct/replay parity, complete synthetic fixtures, and compact survivor retention.
primary_metric: External CLI wall time; checkpointed throughput is separately reported, and service-stage timings overlap so are not summed.

scheduling_disposition.selected: portable O3, work chunk16, 34 threads, batch16384; heldout pending final source freeze
scheduling_disposition.threads_34_first_pair_note: Control external wall was 3.595s, much slower than other 50k controls; retain raw result but do not use it as the estimate.

control.note: Service component times overlap and are not additive; external-minus-internal is an unseparated envelope for process startup/CLI setup/harness sampling, not a startup-only measurement.

selected.note: Service component times overlap and are not additive; external-minus-internal is an unseparated envelope for process startup/CLI setup/harness sampling, not a startup-only measurement.

service_stage_measurement.source: finalist-34-16384-vs-default pair-00 and pair-01 receipts (same 50k tuning cohort)

w2_disposition.monitor_and_shutdown: Shutdown service median is recorded; process-tree RSS was sampled every 0.5s (3 or 4 samples), so these are sampled peaks. The sampler runs in the external harness; its own CPU/wall share was not isolated.
w2_disposition.queue_pressure: Pipeline state records 13 batches/4 batches, at most 3 outstanding in both arms, and about 501004 estimated prepared-owned bytes maximum. queue_wait_seconds is cumulative/overlapping and cannot be read as exclusive wall time. No queue-pressure variant was tested.
w2_disposition.receipts_and_sqlite: Each run validated exactly 50000 retention-receipt inputs, checkpoint coverage, and SQLite integrity. Bytes/input, WAL peak, SQL, commit, writer-wall, and record hashes are retained per observation.
w2_disposition.record_extraction_serialization: record, encoding, and hash service medians are reported; they overlap native/writer activity. Candidate output is only two retained inputs on this cohort.
w2_disposition.seed_packing_and_prepare: Seed preparation, preparation wall, prepare, and task preparation medians are measured per arm in service_stage_measurement; no separate packing variant was built.
w2_disposition.startup_cli_harness: External CLI wall minus internal scan wall medians are recorded per arm; the difference bundles process startup, Python/CLI setup, and process-tree sampling, so none is attributed to startup alone.

delayed_stronghold.disposition: Current delayed placement is measured as a combined stage; no alternate placement A/B was run. Keep it, with alternate placement deferred.
delayed_stronghold.evidence: W2 profile stage 0 (discovery plus delayed query) was 0.073350s of 0.242350s one-thread C wall. The current compact path delays the exact Stronghold query until two cheap structure slots pass.

fatal_floor_early_exit_and_v2_classifica.disposition: Correctness gate is passed. No old-policy side-by-side timing was run, so policy-semantic savings are not attributed to same-policy throughput.
fatal_floor_early_exit_and_v2_classifica.evidence: All seven builds passed exact v2 natural Python/direct/replay, complete-fixture, and compact-retention parity. Benchmarks all use the corrected v2 policy.

filter_order.disposition: Preserve current order; candidate-preserving A/B remains unmeasured and is not claimed exhausted.
filter_order.evidence: All trials ran the same corrected v2 order and passed semantic parity. W2 timings include existing stage totals, but no alternative filter ordering was compiled or timed.

mineshaft_and_palette.disposition: Mineshaft contribution is small/rare in this sample; palette share among positives is meaningful but based on only two candidates. No patch; optimize only with candidate-preserving positive-fixture trials.
mineshaft_and_palette.evidence: Mineshaft floor stage: 2 calls / 0.008795s in 512 inputs. Biome palette: 2 calls / 0.056990s, both on positive inputs.

queue_pressure.disposition: No queue-cap/pressure variant was tested; retain current bounded queue; effect remains unmeasured.
queue_pressure.evidence: For finalist runs max outstanding batches was 3 in both arms, with 13 batches at control settings and 4 at selected settings; maximum prepared-owned estimate was 501004 bytes. queue_wait_seconds is cumulative and overlaps other intervals.

scratch_generator_and_cache_reuse.disposition: Reuse is already implemented; no change warranted from this matrix.
scratch_generator_and_cache_reuse.evidence: Static C audit shows per-worker scratch/flags grow through nb_reserve; ss_create occurs once per worker in a native call; mansion cache resets per input. W2 sample observed 30 mansion queries and 0 hits.

seed_packing_preparation.disposition: No packing implementation variant was measured; these shares do not justify a patch by themselves.
seed_packing_preparation.evidence: Median seed_preparation, preparation_wall, prepare, and task_preparation timings appear per arm in service_stage_measurement. External-minus-internal wall is also reported.

serialization_receipts_sqlite_monitor_sh.disposition: No variant measured. The measured pipeline shows no standalone writer/SQLite bottleneck; monitor cost is not isolated. Do not claim these paths exhausted.
serialization_receipts_sqlite_monitor_sh.evidence: See per-arm finalist service medians and observations for record/encoding/hash, writer/SQL/commit/shutdown, retention receipts, SQLite bytes/WAL/integrity, process-tree RSS, and external/internal wall. Timings overlap.

threads_batch_chunks_and_compiler.disposition: Select O3/chunk16/34 threads/batch16384 provisionally; final confirmation is pending untouched heldout cohort.
threads_batch_chunks_and_compiler.evidence: The bounded matrices and exact order-balanced pairs are summarized in compiler_disposition, scheduling_disposition, and work_chunk_disposition.

zero_reject_allocations_and_allocation_b.disposition: Reject-path allocation is not zero; allocation-only savings are unmeasured. Defer a zero-allocation patch; do not claim optimization exhaustion.
zero_reject_allocations_and_allocation_b.evidence: One-thread W2 top-level residual is 0.032816s/13.54% of 0.242350s C wall, an upper bound including non-allocation work. nb_alloc uses atomic capture to reserve bytes. Discovery-copy storage and NBAnchor result storage allocate per seed before later rejects. Eight call sites; exact dynamic calls were not instrumented.

w2_profile.caveat: Diagnostic instrumentation is not a throughput claim; top-level stage times exclude nested inventory substage aggregation.

work_chunk_disposition.decision: Keep chunk16. Chunk64 checkpoint throughput was lower despite a favorable external-wall ratio; chunk128 was slower in both.
